mapper.select: WITH data AS ( SELECT Max(a.date_of_death) dod, Max(s.calc_collection_date) hiv_calc_dt, Max(e.calc_collection_date) std_calc_dt FROM person_doc_association p LEFT OUTER JOIN document_person_attr a ON (a.document_id = p.document_id AND a.date_of_death IS NOT NULL) LEFT OUTER JOIN std_hiv_eclrs_doc s ON (p.document_id = s.document_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN std_std_eclrs_doc e ON (p.document_id = e.document_id) WHERE p.dissassociation_date IS NULL AND p.stateno in (#{stateno1}, #{stateno2}) ) SELECT 'Y' FROM data WHERE dod < hiv_calc_dt OR dod < std_calc_dt

select history.*, curr.Currently_NEW from ( select c.origin_desc ORIGIN, sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*7)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek1", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*6)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek2", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*5)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek3", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*4)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek4", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*3)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek5", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*2)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek6", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*1)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek7", sum ( case when (d.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*0)) then d.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "MergeReportWeek8" from coded_merge_origins c left join weekly_count_of_new d on d.origin_code = c.origin_code where (c.END_DATE is NULL or c.END_DATE > sysdate) group by c.origin_desc order by c.origin_desc asc ) history full outer join ( select a.origin_desc ORIGIN, sum( case when ( b.status_cd='NEW' ) then 1 else 0 end ) as Currently_NEW from coded_merge_origins a left join nyehms_duplicate_statenos b on b.origin_code = a.origin_code
where (a.END_DATE is NULL or a.END_DATE > sysdate) and b.stateno_1 in (select stateno from person where flag_active='Y') and b.stateno_2 in (select stateno from person where flag_active='Y') group by a.origin_desc order by a.origin_desc asc ) curr on history.ORIGIN = curr.ORIGIN

select history."BadMergesWeek1", history."BadMergesWeek2", history."BadMergesWeek3", history."BadMergesWeek4", history."BadMergesWeek5", history."BadMergesWeek6", history."BadMergesWeek7", history."BadMergesWeek8", curr.Currently_NEW from ( select 1 as dummyId, sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*7)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek1", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*6)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek2", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*5)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek3", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*4)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek4", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*3)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek5", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*2)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek6", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*1)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek7", sum ( case when (wnb.run_date = (trunc(sysdate, 'd') - 2 - 7*0)) then wnb.count_of_new else 0 end ) as "BadMergesWeek8" from weekly_new_bad_merges wnb group by 1 ) history full outer join ( select 1 as dummyId, sum( case when ( unm.status_cd='NEW' ) then 1 else 0 end ) as Currently_NEW from nyehms_unmerging_statenos unm join person p on unm.stateno = p.stateno and p.flag_active = 'Y' group by 1 ) curr on history.dummyId = curr.dummyId

select to_char(trunc(a.last_updated_date, 'IW'), 'yyyy_mm_dd') WEEKOF, to_char(a.last_updated_date, 'mm/dd/yyyy') UPDATED_DATE, to_char(a.last_updated_date, 'DAY') DAY_NAME, b.legacy_uid UPDATED_USER, a.status_cd STATUS, count(*) COUNT from nyehms_duplicate_statenos a join nyehms_users b on a.last_updated_by = b.worker_id where a.last_updated_date between to_date(#{fromDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') and to_date(#{toDate}, 'MM/DD/YYYY')+1 and a.status_cd in ('ACCEPT', 'REJECT') group by to_char(trunc(a.last_updated_date, 'IW'), 'yyyy_mm_dd'), to_char(a.last_updated_date, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), to_char(a.last_updated_date, 'DAY'), b.legacy_uid, a.status_cd order by to_date(updated_date, 'mm/dd/yyyy'), UPDATED_USER, STATUS
